keyFindings.description: An event that commits for an owner while that owner is in flight can be left unread until an unrelated wake or the next back-off (up to retry.MaxDelay, 5 min). Its wake is taken by the scan (lease.go:484) and starts a batch that skips the owner; the owner's batch, held by a silent holder (send.connection set by ErrNotAcknowledged, so settleOwner skips it, publisher.go:263-268), releases it only at its end through lanes.release, which wakes nothing (lease.go:581); and missed is set only when a batch read zero rows (batch.sendable == 0). So if the skipping batch read any other owner (an issue whose role-forward retry fell due, the usual state under a silent role), the owner's new event is never re-read when the scan returns; nextRetry sees only rows with next_attempt_at set. Its topic and session copies, which before 767794be went out right after the batch, wait minutes. Fix: record in lanes.reserve that a read ran with owners excluded and set missed from that, or wake on a batch-end release that is not natsLost, blocked or fenced; test with a second issue whose retry falls due as e2 commits.

settleOwner (publisher.go:259-309) duplicates the batch-end settle+record (356-401): when it returns without recording (a released event, or a passed deadline), the batch end settles the same events again, and settleEvent's backOff logs the ERROR line (and the dead-letter line at attempt 10) twice for one attempt. Extract one settle-and-record helper used by both.

verifiedCorrect: No two batches hold one owner: lanes.reserve reads and takes owners under lanes.mu; an early release comes after recordBatch committed, so a re-read sees the record; per-(owner, destination) order holds across batches.

Fencing: every early record checks the deadline and the SQL hold check; fenced, NATS-lost and failed batches end the others; scan returns only at inflight 0 and publish releases the hold after serve returns, so no record follows Release; done is buffered to concurrentBatches, so no slot leaks.
4fc3e0d2: Request reads deniedPublish under its own sentAt on the request goroutine (flush-unconfirmed and timer arm); holder and unanswered metric reasons with HELP and docs updated.
Merges: migrations 0150_duty_holds/0151_outbox_claim after 0149_event_horizon, connections 91, #2542's HookedConnectionEvents beside ConnectionChanged.
